name: bug-report
description: Verify suspected upstream defects, use their documented reporting channel, and follow up for one fixed 30-minute window.

run.reason: Current-context reporting uses the scoped agreement; no child or extra review is implied.
run.completion_evidence: reviewed redacted report at approved destination

resume.reason: Reuse the scoped agreement and producing evidence without chooser; reconcile owned handles and retain findings/budgets.
resume.completion_evidence: same report, owned handles and remaining budget

status.reason: Read-only incident inspection has no synthesis or dispatch.

cancel.reason: Record cancellation and reconcile only the incident's owned monitoring task; no worker dispatch or unrelated cleanup.
cancel.completion_evidence: owned work stopped; partial evidence retained
